title: Juicy Snappy Polish Pork Skewers
description: A solo dinner dish featuring pork, redcurrants, and pickle, with a nutty and snappy flavor profile, made according to Whole30 guidelines.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the almond flour mixture.
Thread the coated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with coconut oil.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, mix the redcurrants and chopped pickle in a small bowl.
Serve the grilled pork skewers with the redcurrant and pickle mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
